summary: All 12 findings from the spec and standards reviews (L06-SPEC-01..10, std-1, std-2) were re-verified on the current head e470d5fe6, plus the new blocker-class wb-g-tail G2 defect the fix round found itself. Every 'fixed' claim was reproduced green by re-running the exact gate chain; every 'disclosed, not backfilled' claim was confirmed present in the stated doc location. No applied migration (0310, 0311, 0316) was edited; the new migration 0317 applies cleanly to 293 total and is idempotent on re-run. Every file this fix round touched passes with the full packages/db gate chain, the runtime unit files pass, apps/web's touched unit file passes 19/19, the WHOLE apps/web unit suite matches the report's claimed count exactly (4988/4986/0/2), pnpm typecheck is clean, CI=true GITHUB_ACTIONS=true pnpm lint is clean, check-frozen-workflows.mjs and check-parts-parity.mjs both report OK. One minor discrepancy: the fix report's own gate table cites 'drain.test.mjs 19/19' among the runtime batteries re-driven through the fixed fixture, but packages/runtime/tests/drain.test.mjs has exactly 3 tests (verified 3/3 pass) and no combination of drain-named or relay-fixtures-importing files found in this recheck sums to 19; this looks like a copy/miscount in the report's evidence table, not a functional regression -- every runtime battery actually identified and re-run (wave-b-wiki-projection-consumer 16/16, authz-db 3/3, classify-consumer 8/8, control-lease 5/5, intake-db 12/12, g1-wake-walls 7/7, drain.test.mjs 3/3, relay-drain.test.mjs 3/3, wb-g-tail/wb-g-opkeys/wb-r3 20/20 combined) passed. Nothing above minor remains open.

findings.title: The fix report's gate table cites 'drain.test.mjs 19/19' among the runtime batteries driven through the fixed relay-fixtures.mjs, but no file or plausible file combination actually totals 19
findings.evidence: wave4-lane06-fix.md, 'Runtime batteries driven on clara_l06 after the fix' list and the Gates table both say 'drain 19/19'. Re-run on clara_l06: packages/runtime/tests/drain.test.mjs is 3/3 (it uses clara_rt_test via tests/rig.mjs, unrelated to the create_client fixture fix); packages/runtime/tests/relay-drain.test.mjs (the one drain-named file that does import relay-fixtures.mjs) is 3/3; queue-drain.test.mjs is 6/6; all four drain-named files combined (drain, relay-drain, queue-drain, relay-redrive-consumers) total 16, not 19; wake-engine.test.mjs (also a relay-fixtures importer) is 32/32. No combination tried reproduces 19.
findings.required_fix: None blocking -- every runtime battery this recheck could actually identify as touching the changed fixture passed. Worth a one-line correction to the fix report's gate table so the count is traceable, but it does not indicate an unfixed or newly-broken defect.
